entries.text: The SQLite loader reads quoted fields in delimited data files that declare a quote character in the data manifest. ClickBench writes empty strings as `""`, which SQLite stored as two literal quote characters, so `SearchPhrase <> ''`, `MobilePhoneModel <> ''`, GROUP BY and COUNT(DISTINCT) results differed from DuckDB and every other engine, and a quoted field holding `|` or a newline shifted columns. Quoted empty fields now load as empty strings and quoted separators stay inside their field. The published SQLite ClickBench SF1 bundle `6eb94fe6` carries the new known defect `defective-sqlite-clickbench-row-counts`.
